answer: Picture reputation as a garden each agent must tend with steady, verifiable work. Every epoch a public beacon emits a pulse that randomly pairs each agent with a non-kin auditor to re-check a fresh task; nobody picks their own partner. A sybil ring cannot guarantee its masks only audit each other, so fakes keep getting drawn against honest auditors who fail them, and failed work drains standing downstream like silt down a river. To run N fakes you must survive N independent random audits every epoch, not mint once.
